lines.text: Oh dear. If only I could help out my senior...
E-Endmin?! Hi ... yeah, I'm An Yu, Tianshi disciple of the Test Area. I'm currently helping my senior Lu Lingxiang fix the local facilities...
Lu is really frustrated about the gas pipes. We also have Blight near the valves that require fixing, but we don't have that many Tianshi to spare...
They said they'll send someone over after a while... But now, plenty of areas are inaccessible due to the broken pipes. Our repair work is getting delayed...
If I knew how to clean up the Blight, I could help Lu solve the issue and make her happy again... She's been sighing non-stop for days...
Oh?! Really? Thank you so much, Endmin!
The valve that needs repairs is located at the bottom of the reservoir next to us. Unfortunately, it is filled with contaminated sewage.
We must get rid of the sewage to fix the valve and shut off the malfunctioning gas discharge pipe.
Endmin, if you have any fluid pumps, we can try using those!
The two valves that need fixing are at the bottom of the reservoir next to us —
Huh. All of them have been closed... What happened...?
Wow! That's why you're the Endmin! Let's just head over to the next valve repair site!

options: I came. I saw. I fixed.

lines.text: AN! YU! I hope you didn't forget what you promised me.
No, of course not! Ah, "no scampering around without permission"... Sorry, Lu...
Just look at you! Not only did you scamper around, you even dragged the Endmin along —
Is that so? Well, An, I guess I owe you an apology.
I never thought you did all this for me... But don't make this excuse for next time! You should know how dangerous this area can be!
When I saw your positioning coordinates just then, my heart almost gave out! Fortunately we have the Endmin with you...
I-I know. There won't be a second time, Lu! If you don't believe me, I'll have the Endmin be my witness!
Fine. I think you deserve the reward for addressing the major problem of the Test Area! Take this.
Wha? Is-is this ... for me?
Yeah. And our Endmin gets one too — Thank you! You just solved another serious issue of the Test Area! Repair work will progress a lot more smoothly now!

options: She wants to make your job easier.

r: She wants to make your job easier.
